faultLoc.explanation: The NullPointerException is thrown because the `charset` variable is null when `newEncoder()` is called. This line does not handle the case where `charset` might be null, leading to the exception.
The initialization of `charsetEncoder` assumes that `super.getCharset()` will never return null. If `super.getCharset()` returns null, this will cause a NullPointerException.
The `getCharset()` method in `AbstractStreamBuilder` returns the `charset` field, which might be null. This method should ensure that it never returns a null value to avoid downstream issues.
The `Builder` class is instantiated without ensuring that all necessary fields are properly initialized. This can lead to issues if any of the fields are accessed before being set.
